description: Ten source-linked exam briefs on defence procurement, infrastructure monitoring, export support, broadcasting regulation, cyclone preparedness, ASEAN defence diplomacy, biotechnology, rural enterprise, naval cooperation and Tamil Nadu public debt.

stories.title: Defence Acquisition Council grants AoN for proposals worth about ₹2.12 lakh crore
stories.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council, chaired by the Defence Minister, granted Acceptance of Necessity on 26 October to capital-acquisition proposals estimated at about ₹2.12 lakh crore. AoN is an in-principle administrative approval, not a completed purchase contract; the proposals cover equipment for all three Services.
key_facts: Approximately 82% of the value covered by the AoNs is intended to be procured from Indian industry.
Army proposals include high-mobility vehicles, tracked self-propelled guns, VSHORADS, counter-UAS systems and multiple surveillance or strike drone systems.
Navy proposals include an Active Offboard Decoy System and major indigenously designed and constructed naval platforms.
Air Force proposals include helicopters, air-defence systems, weapons and mobile X-band Doppler weather radar systems.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Defence Acquisition Council, the meaning of Acceptance of Necessity, and the stages of capital procurement under the Defence Acquisition Procedure.
stories.source_title: PIB, DAC clears capital acquisition proposals worth Rs 2.12 lakh crore — 26 October 2026

stories.title: PAIMANA tracks 1,853 central infrastructure projects worth ₹37.56 lakh crore
stories.summary: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation's September 2026 flash report, released on 26 October, said the PAIMANA platform was monitoring 1,853 ongoing central-sector infrastructure projects across 17 ministries and departments. The figures describe the monitored portfolio and should not be read as all infrastructure investment in India.
key_facts: Cumulative expenditure was ₹17.73 lakh crore, or 47.21% of the latest project cost of ₹37.56 lakh crore.
Transport and logistics accounted for 1,320 projects, while energy accounted for 225; together they represented 83.4% of the project count.
The portfolio contained 780 mega projects costing at least ₹1,000 crore and 1,073 major projects below that threshold.
The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways had the largest project count at 974, followed by Railways with 284.
stories.exam_link: Study MoSPI's role in official statistics and infrastructure monitoring, and distinguish physical progress, financial progress and revised project cost.
stories.source_title: PIB, Monthly Flash Report on Central Sector Infrastructure Projects — 26 October 2026

stories.title: RELIEF Component II extended until 31 March 2027
stories.summary: The Department of Commerce announced that Component II of the Resilience and Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation initiative under the Export Promotion Mission has been extended to 31 March 2027. The measure responds to continuing West Asian disruptions affecting Gulf maritime logistics; it is an extension of support, not a claim that those disruptions have ended.
key_facts: Component II offers 95% risk coverage to encourage exporters to obtain ECGC cover for upcoming eligible shipments.
The benefit applies to eligible standalone and whole-turnover policies obtained on or after 16 March 2026.
Eligible cargo categories include full-container-load, less-than-container-load and refrigerated containers; energy shipments are excluded.
Premiums for eligible exporters are protected against increases beyond pre-disruption levels during the eligible period.
stories.exam_link: Revise the role of ECGC, export credit insurance, political-risk cover and the distinction between merchandise-export facilitation and an export subsidy.
stories.source_title: PIB, Department of Commerce extends RELIEF Component II — 26 October 2026

stories.title: TRAI recommends a distinct authorisation category for internet-based linear television
stories.summary: TRAI released recommendations for an authorisation framework covering Application-based Linear Television Distribution services, including Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television. It proposed ALTD as a distinct sub-category under television-channel distribution services within the Telecommunications Act, 2023 framework; recommendations are advisory until accepted and implemented by the Government.
key_facts: ALTD covers applications that aggregate and distribute scheduled linear television channels over public internet or other IP-based networks.
TRAI described its approach as light-touch and future-ready, aimed at innovation, consumer protection and regulatory certainty.
TRAI recommended a master repository of authorised ALTD apps, with device and operating-system providers allowing only authorised apps.
The application provider would be the primary point of contact for consumer grievances, and authorised services could distribute only validly permitted or registered channels.
stories.exam_link: Revise TRAI's recommendatory role under the TRAI Act, 1997, and the authorisation framework under the Telecommunications Act, 2023.
stories.source_title: TRAI, recommendations on ALTD authorisation framework — 26 October 2026

stories.title: NCMC reviews preparedness as Cyclone Arnab develops over the Bay of Bengal
stories.summary: The Cabinet Secretary chaired a National Crisis Management Committee meeting on 26 October to review preparedness for Cyclone Arnab. IMD reported that a deep depression had intensified into a cyclonic storm over the east-central and adjoining west-central Bay of Bengal; positions and forecasts in the release were time-specific and not final landfall observations.
key_facts: At 05:30 IST on 26 October, the system was about 650 km east-southeast of Visakhapatnam and 730 km east-southeast of Kakinada.
NCMC is chaired by the Cabinet Secretary and coordinates central preparedness and response during major crises.
The India Meteorological Department is the country's designated agency for tropical-cyclone monitoring and warning over the north Indian Ocean.
stories.exam_link: Revise the institutional chain for disaster management: IMD warnings, state authorities, the National Executive Committee and the Cabinet Secretary-led NCMC.
stories.source_title: PIB, NCMC reviews preparedness for Cyclone Arnab — 26 October 2026

stories.title: India announces participation in the 13th ADMM-Plus in the Philippines
stories.summary: The Defence Ministry announced that the Defence Minister will lead India's delegation to the 13th ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting-Plus in Cebu, Philippines, on 28–29 October. Because the meeting was still upcoming on the edition date, the item records the announced participation rather than a completed diplomatic outcome.
key_facts: The Indian delegation is scheduled to address an exchange of views on regional and international security issues.
ADMM-Plus is an ASEAN-led platform that brings ASEAN defence ministers together with eight dialogue partners, including India.
The venue announced for the 13th meeting is Cebu in the Philippines.
stories.exam_link: Revise ASEAN's ten members, the eight ADMM-Plus partners and the difference between the ASEAN Summit, ARF, East Asia Summit and ADMM-Plus.
stories.source_title: PIB, Raksha Mantri to lead Indian delegation at 13th ADMM-Plus — 26 October 2026

stories.title: ICGEB event highlights systems and synthetic biology ahead of ESTIC 2026
stories.summary: ICGEB New Delhi held a curtain-raiser for the Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave 2026, with a session on systems and synthetic biology. Officials discussed translating research into scalable applications in health, agriculture, biomanufacturing and sustainability; the main conclave was scheduled for 27–29 October and had not yet concluded.
key_facts: ESTIC 2026 is scheduled at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, and is organised by CSIR under guidance of the Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser.
The conclave covers 12 thematic areas, including systems and synthetic biology, advanced manufacturing, energy technologies, artificial intelligence, semiconductors and advanced healthcare.
Systems biology studies interacting components of biological systems, while synthetic biology applies engineering principles to design or modify biological functions.
ICGEB is an international organisation with a New Delhi component focused on research and training in life sciences.
stories.exam_link: Revise systems biology, synthetic biology, gene circuits and the roles of DBT, CSIR, BIRAC and the Principal Scientific Adviser.
stories.source_title: PIB, ICGEB hosts ESTIC 2026 curtain-raiser — 26 October 2026

stories.title: National SARAS Mela profiles SHG enterprises scaling beyond lakhpati status
stories.summary: The Rural Development Ministry highlighted women-led Self-Help Group enterprises at the National SARAS Mela in Vijayawada. The event was organised with the Andhra Pradesh government and support from NABARD, NIRDPR and Kudumbashree, linking rural producers with consumers, learning opportunities and wider markets.
key_facts: The Vijayawada edition is the first National SARAS Mela held outside the Delhi-NCR region.
The wider mela runs from 13 to 31 October at Punnami Ghat and brings together about 1,500 women entrepreneurs from 34 States and Union Territories.
SARAS Melas operate within the rural-livelihood ecosystem associated with DAY-NRLM and women's Self-Help Groups.
Lakhpati Didi refers to women SHG members enabled to earn a sustainable annual household income of at least ₹1 lakh.
stories.exam_link: Revise DAY-NRLM, SHG-bank linkage, the role of NABARD and the difference between livelihood promotion and direct income transfer.
stories.source_title: PIB, Journeys of Lakhpati Didis at National SARAS Mela 2026 — 26 October 2026

stories.title: INS Trishul reaches Italy after passage exercise with the Italian Navy
stories.summary: INS Trishul arrived at Civitavecchia, Italy, on 25 October during a Mediterranean operational deployment, with the official release issued the next day. Before entering harbour, it conducted a Passage Exercise with the Italian Navy ship Carlo Margottini, demonstrating operational cooperation rather than a treaty or permanent deployment.
key_facts: The PASSEX included coordinated manoeuvres, communications, replenishment approaches, cross-deck landings, personnel transfers and boarding operations.
Civitavecchia is a port on Italy's Tyrrhenian coast and serves the Rome region.
A passage exercise is generally conducted when navies meet at sea and does not require a long pre-planned multilateral exercise format.
stories.exam_link: Revise naval diplomacy, passage exercises, India's Mediterranean outreach and the distinction among port calls, PASSEX and full-scale bilateral exercises.
stories.source_title: PIB, INS Trishul arrives at Civitavecchia, Italy — 26 October 2026

stories.title: Tamil Nadu's 7.23% State Development Loan reaches scheduled redemption
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu's Finance Department had notified that the outstanding 7.23% Tamil Nadu State Development Loan, 2026 would be repaid at par on 26 October, with interest due through 25 October. The item concerns redemption of an existing state government security, not a fresh borrowing or a debt waiver.
key_facts: No interest accrues on the security from 26 October 2026 onward.
Payment is made to registered holders through the prescribed Public Debt Office, treasury or bank procedures, using bank-account details where available.
State Development Loans are market borrowings of state governments issued as dated government securities, generally through RBI-managed auctions.
stories.exam_link: Revise State Development Loans, the RBI's debt-management role, government securities, coupon payments and redemption at par.
stories.source_title: Government of Tamil Nadu Finance Department, repayment of 7.23% Tamil Nadu SDL — 24 September 2026

mcqs.question: In India's defence procurement process, Acceptance of Necessity most accurately signifies which stage?
options: Signing of the final supply contract
mcqs.explanation: The DAC granted AoN as in-principle administrative approval; it does not itself mean that a purchase contract has been signed.

mcqs.question: What share of the value covered by the 26 October DAC approvals is intended for procurement from Indian industry?
mcqs.explanation: The official release states that approximately 82% of the procurements covered by the AoNs will be from Indian industry.

mcqs.question: Which platform did MoSPI use for monitoring the 1,853 central-sector infrastructure projects reported for September 2026?
mcqs.explanation: MoSPI's flash report said the projects were being monitored through the PAIMANA platform.

mcqs.question: Under RELIEF Component II, the announced risk coverage for eligible export shipments is what percentage?
mcqs.explanation: Component II offers 95% risk coverage to encourage eligible exporters to obtain ECGC cover.

mcqs.question: Which category is excluded from the cargo coverage listed for RELIEF Component II?
mcqs.explanation: The official announcement includes FCL, LCL and reefer containers but excludes energy shipments.

mcqs.question: TRAI recommended placing ALTD Services as a distinct sub-category under which broader service group?
mcqs.explanation: TRAI proposed ALTD as a distinct sub-category under Television Channel Distribution Services.

mcqs.question: What is the legal character of TRAI's 26 October ALTD document at the time of release?
options: A directly enforceable Act of Parliament
mcqs.explanation: TRAI issued recommendations; implementation requires action by the competent government authority.

mcqs.question: Who chairs the National Crisis Management Committee that reviewed Cyclone Arnab preparedness?
mcqs.explanation: The NCMC is chaired by the Cabinet Secretary, while IMD provides meteorological assessment and warnings.

mcqs.question: The 13th ADMM-Plus announced for 28–29 October 2026 is to be held in which country?
mcqs.explanation: The meeting was announced for Cebu in the Philippines.

mcqs.question: ADMM-Plus is best described as which type of forum?
options: An ASEAN-led defence dialogue with eight partners
mcqs.explanation: ADMM-Plus connects ASEAN defence ministers with eight dialogue partners, including India.

mcqs.question: Which institution hosted the 26 October curtain-raiser on systems and synthetic biology?
mcqs.explanation: The International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology's New Delhi component hosted the event.

mcqs.question: The Vijayawada National SARAS Mela is mainly associated with which participants?
mcqs.explanation: SARAS Melas provide market and learning platforms for rural women entrepreneurs organised through Self-Help Groups.

mcqs.question: Before reaching Civitavecchia, INS Trishul conducted a PASSEX with the navy of which country?
mcqs.explanation: INS Trishul conducted the passage exercise with Italian Naval Ship Carlo Margottini.

mcqs.question: What happened to Tamil Nadu's 7.23% SDL on 26 October 2026?
options: It was scheduled for repayment at par
It was converted into municipal debt
mcqs.explanation: The state notification provided for redemption at par on 26 October, with interest due through the previous day.

mcqs.question: State Development Loans are best classified as which instrument?
mcqs.explanation: SDLs are dated government securities through which state governments borrow from the market.
